pages.title: Bramble Snare
pages.text: $(l)Nature$(). Thorned vines lash out at the creature you look at and bind it: it cannot move for three seconds, and the thorns tear at it.$(br2)$(l)II:$() the vines catch everything within 3 blocks of your target.$(br)$(l)III:$() longer, harder, and poisoned.

pages.title: Hunter's Mark
pages.text: $(l)Divination$(). Mark what you look at. It glows, cannot turn invisible, and takes $(l)30%$() more damage from everything for ten seconds.$(br2)A glowing creature is also $(l)Exposed$(): magic strikes it harder still. A $(l)Huntsman's Charm$() keeps everything near you glowing, too.$(br2)$(l)II:$() 15 s, 40%. $(l)III:$() 20 s, 50%.
